qualification.details: Completed Graduation from a Recognized University. Completed the Ayushman Mitra Training Course and passed the respective course exam/certification. Possessing fluent communication skills in Hindi/English and Local language of the State/region. Having adequate functional computer literacy which shall include understanding of Microsoft Office Suit and navigating through Internet Portals. Candidate should also be proficient in computer typing (typing speed of 30 wpm in English and 25 wpm in Hindi). Preference to be given to Female Candidates. Qualified ASHA workers may be given preference.

selection_process: Walk-in Interview Test if number of candidates is more
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PGIMS Rohtak Ayushman Mitra Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ayushman Mitra post at PGIMS Rohtak?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Ayushman Mitra position at PGIMS Rohtak is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Ayushman Mitra role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed their Graduation from a recognized university and also possess a completed Ayushman Mitra Training Course with a passing certification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Ayushman Mitra position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive an honorarium of Rs. 5,000 per month, along with a commission of Rs. 50 for every processed claim completed.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Ayushman Mitra post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies announced for the Ayushman Mitra position at PGIMS Rohtak in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Ayushman Mitra recruitment at PGIMS Rohtak is to be done via Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Ayushman Mitra post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Ayushman Mitra position at PGIMS Rohtak, as per the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the key skills required for an Ayushman Mitra?
faq.answer: Essential skills include fluent communication in Hindi/English and the local language, functional computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Internet), and proficiency in computer typing (30 wpm English, 25 wpm Hindi).

faq.question: Q8. Are there any preferences given to certain candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to female candidates. Additionally, qualified ASHA workers may also be given preference for the Ayushman Mitra role.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Ayushman Mitra recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview. However, a test may be conducted if there is a large number of applicants.
